ideas.topic: The Pharaoh Who Was Erased From History
ideas.hook: Archaeologists found his name, but his own people tried to wipe him from existence.
ideas.why: It mirrors the 'Mummy Buried In Disgrace' pattern by focusing on intrigue and the dramatic human cost of ancient political revenge.

ideas.topic: The 3 Most Terrifying Creatures of the Duat
ideas.hook: You thought the serpent Apophis was scary? Ancient Egyptians feared these three beasts even more.
ideas.why: It leverages the high-performing 'Biggest Serpents' listicle format while maintaining your channel's specific focus on Egyptian mythology.

ideas.topic: How Ancient Egyptians Actually Kept Their Teeth Clean
ideas.hook: Forget modern toothpaste; ancient Egyptians had a surprisingly abrasive solution for a perfect smile.
ideas.why: It utilizes the curiosity-gap pattern seen in the 'Unique Jobs' videos by highlighting a relatable, surprising aspect of daily life in the ancient world.
